name: engine_partitions_5m_warm
description: The engine at its default (one partition per core, decision D-21) and at 50,000, 125,000 and 250,000 rows per partition (100, 40 and 20 tasks per pass at 5 million rows) on the datasets of compare_5m, four repeats, in one session, with the stored table read and the Python workers started before every timed fit.
